💡 Se-doped Co3O4/SnO2 hollow nanoboxes combine heterointerface engineering with electronic structure modulation for Li-S battery separators. item.title: Synergistic interfacial engineering of MXene/carbon nano-onion heterostructures for accelerated polysulfide kinetics and durable lithium–sulfur batteries
item.description:
هتروساختار MXene/carbon nano-onion با بازتوزیع بار و تخلخل سلسله‌مراتبی، جذب پلی‌سولفید و تبدیل گوگرد را تقویت کرده و پایداری چرخه Li-S را بهبود می‌دهد.
Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in MXene/carbon nano-onion heterostructures that combine interfacial charge redistribution with hierarchical porosity. This synergy strengthens polysulfide retention and accelerates sulfur conversion kinetics, enabling durable lithium–sulfur batteries with improved cycling stability. The work highlights rational interfacial engineering as a significant strategy for high-performance energy storage.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · MXene · carbon nano-onion · polysulfide kinetics · heterostructure

💡 The novelty lies in a one-step solid-state calcination creating a coherent LSO–LMO oxide–oxide heterostructure interface without atomic reconstruction or bond breaking. This robust interfacial design enables fast charging and enhanced cycling stability, offering a scalable, structurally stable coating strategy for high-power lithium-ion battery cathodes.

item.title: High‐Entropy Prussian Blue Analogues Enable Ultrastable Sodium Storage Via Charge Redistribution‐Induced Jahn–Teller Suppression
item.description:
مهندسی آنتروپی بالا در Prussian blue analogues با پنج فلز، توزیع بار و سرکوب Jahn-Teller را تقویت کرده و پایداری چرخه کاتد سدیم‌یون را به‌طور چشمگیری بهبود می‌دهد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using high-entropy engineering with five transition metals (Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu) to create a compositionally complex N-coordinated sublattice in Prussian blue analogues, redistributing charge and suppressing Jahn–Teller distortion. This significantly enhances sodium-ion battery cathode stability, retaining 75.3% capacity after 600 cycles versus 33.0% for Mn-PBA, demonstrating a viable strategy for durable PBA cathodes.
🏷 high-entropy PBA · sodium-ion battery cathode · Jahn-Teller suppression · charge redistribution · Prussian blue analogues
